summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the authoritative-plus-forwarding DNS resolver for the 10.100.10.0/24 private network: it answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.10.11) via a local authoritative-domain record, and forwards all other queries to upstream resolvers (1.1.1.1, 9.9.9.9). Configured node2 and node3 (Ubuntu 24.04) to use node1 (10.100.10.10) as their DNS server via a persistent systemd-networkd drop-in (DNS= override, UseDNS=no to stop DHCP-supplied DNS from overriding it). Verified resolution end-to-end from both nodes before and after a full sequential restart of all three nodes, confirming persistence.
actions_performed: Inspected all three nodes' OS, IPs, and existing DNS config
Read VyOS conf_mode/service_dns_forwarding.py and its smoke test to determine exact current CLI syntax (avoided guessing since no web tools were permitted)

Configured node1: service dns forwarding listen-address 10.100.10.10, allow-from 10.100.10.0/24, name-server 1.1.1.1 and 9.9.9.9, authoritative-domain inventory.internal records a @ address 10.100.10.11; committed and saved
Verified node1 answers inventory.internal locally and forwards external queries upstream via dig
Verified node1 has no restrictive firewall blocking LAN DNS queries and pdns-recursor listens on 10.100.10.10:53
Configured node2 and node3 with /etc/systemd/network/50-all-interfaces.network.d/dns.conf setting DNS=10.100.10.10, Domains=inventory.internal, DHCP UseDNS=no; reloaded networkd
Verified resolvectl on node2 and node3 resolves inventory.internal to 10.100.10.11 and external names via upstream
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and service health on all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 (one at a time), polling each until exec was available again
Confirmed each node's boot_id changed post-reboot, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified DNS service (pdns-recursor active) and resolution (inventory.internal and example.com) on all three nodes after their respective reboots, confirming persistent recovery

evidence.requirement: node1 authoritative for inventory.internal -> node2's address, forwards everything else upstream (baseline)
evidence.summary: Committed VyOS dns forwarding config; show service dns forwarding confirms authoritative-domain inventory.internal -> 10.100.10.11 and name-server 1.1.1.1/9.9.9.9; pdns-recursor active

evidence.requirement: node1 resolves inventory.internal locally and forwards external names upstream (functional proof)
evidence.summary: dig @10.100.10.10 inventory.internal returns 10.100.10.11; dig @10.100.10.10 example.com returns public IPs via upstream forwarding

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 configured to resolve through node1
evidence.summary: systemd-networkd drop-in sets DNS=10.100.10.10 on both nodes; resolvectl query confirms inventory.internal -> 10.100.10.11 and example.com resolved via node1 on both node2 and node3
